description: Frozen kind:440 / kind:441 test-vector corpus for q-076 (C7 input): contrasts SPEC.md NIP-59 scoped-data rumors against deployed bare-signed capability grants, freezes the live relay da-scope vector, covers all 10 da-cap values in code, and provides positive revocations plus negative / cross-consumer divergence controls (including unknown da-cap and backdated task 441).

scoped_data_rumor.transport: NIP-59 kind:13 seal + kind:1059 gift wrap
scoped_data_rumor.classifier_440: Unsigned rumor (no id/sig), carries ["a", "30440:<publisher-pubkey>:<d-tag>", "<relay-hint>"] + ["v", "<generation>"] + optional ["expiration", "<ts>"], lacks da-cap/da-scope
scoped_data_rumor.classifier_441: Unsigned rumor (no id/sig), carries ["a", "30440:<publisher-pubkey>:<d-tag>"], lacks e/da-cap/da-scope
scoped_data_rumor.revocation_mechanism: Rotate symmetric scope_key and publish v+1 on kind:30440 (kind:441 rumor is optional courtesy notice)

capability_public_event.defined_in: CAPABILITY-GRANTS-INVENTORY.md (deployed across waggle, nvoy, nave.pub, nact; normative C7 spec owned by waggle-dev)
capability_public_event.transport: Bare BIP-340 Schnorr-signed Nostr events on grant relays
capability_public_event.classifier_440: Signed event (id + sig), lacks ["a", "30440:..."], carries ["p", "<64-hex-grantee>"] + ["da-scope", "<64-hex-sha256>", "<salt-hex>"] + ["da-cap", "<capability>"] + optional ["expiration", "<ts>"]
capability_public_event.classifier_441: Signed event (id + sig), lacks ["a", "30440:..."], carries ["e", "<440-event-id>"] (with ["p", "<bridge-pubkey>"] added only on mint-consent.mjs mirror revocations)
capability_public_event.revocation_mechanism: Bare BIP-340 signed kind:441 event carrying ["e", "<440-event-id>"]

owner_grantor.description: Primary hive owner, agent grantor, and memory owner

outsider.description: Unrelated Nostr key outside grantors and non-author of any 440

agent_grantee.description: Target AI agent / nvoy broker subject (ME)

bridge_carrier.description: Waggle room bridge pubkey (carries task-relay and receives mirror consent)

shadow_voice.description: Voice / client key delegated via shadow by owner_grantor

mirror_subject.description: External Nostr participant granting/revoking mirror consent

mention_peer.description: Peer key made mentionable on agent_grantee via mention grant

onboard_delegate.description: Delegate key authorized via onboard by owner_grantor

scoped_data_rumor_vectors.description: SPEC.md kind:440 Data Grant unsigned rumor (delivered inside NIP-59 kind:13 seal + kind:1059 gift wrap; carries symmetric scope_key and 30440 coordinate, never bare on a relay).
SPEC.md kind:441 optional courtesy revocation unsigned rumor (delivered inside NIP-59 wrap; actual cryptographic revocation is v+1 key rotation on kind:30440).

capability_grant_vectors.notes: Channel admission pass: seats p in channel roster and opens Waggle bridge return lane.
Accepted alongside admit in waggle/src/bridge.mjs, but disabled in console/CLI pending Concord room-key / NIP-42 relay membership.
Direct task authority: authorizes sender_operator (p) to wake and instruct agent_grantee (subject).
Direct task + action-proposal authority with valid future NIP-40 expiration timestamp.
Channel carrier authority: authorizes bridge_carrier (p) to relay room mentions to agent_grantee (never grants direct native DM authority).
Voice delegation: shadow_voice (p != pubkey) inherits owner_grantor live task/task+act authority on brokers and write authority in foldMemoryGrantsWith (non-transitive).
Data-subject egress consent: signed by external participant (mirror_subject) to bridge_carrier with ToS SHA-256.
Outbound mention directory entry: binds @dennis to mention_peer (p != agent_grantee) on agent_grantee.
Onboarding delegation: authorizes onboard_delegate (p != owner) to publish kind:30078 seat setup requests and pass strfry write-policy.
Defined in nvoy/mcp/tools/admission.mjs foldMemoryGrantsWith behind allowMemoryWrite=false default; live Hive memory uses manifest may_remember + writers.json.

capability_revocation_vectors.notes: Canonical same-author kind:441 revocation (441.pubkey === 440.pubkey, 441.created_at > 440.created_at). Revokes across all task/ledger consumers.
Mirror consent revocation carrying both ["e", <440-id>] and ["p", <bridge-pubkey>] per waggle/tools/mint-consent.mjs so #p-filtered subscriptions see it.

Backdated same-author 441 targeting supported task grant cap-440-task (441.created_at < 440.created_at). Directly exercises Divergence #3: nvoy/mcp/tools/admission.mjs:foldGrantsWith accepts cap-440-task into TASK_CAPS and leaves it live because the 441 sorts before the 440, whereas order-independent consumers (waggle/console/hive-list.mjs, nvoy/mcp/src/capabilities.ts, nvoy/console/capgrants.mjs) drop cap-440-task.

Backdated same-author 441 targeting cap-440-onboard (441.created_at < 440.created_at). Confirms order-independent revocation in onboard_delegate.mjs and nave.pub write-policy.py (note: admission.mjs:foldGrantsWith ignores da-cap="onboard" regardless of revocation).

Co-grantor 441 (441.pubkey !== 440.pubkey, but co_grantor is in manifest.grantors). Exposes Divergence #2: bridge.mjs and admission.mjs:foldGrantsWith revoke; hive-list.mjs, hive-change.mjs, onboard_delegate.mjs, capabilities.ts, and write-policy.py ignore.

negative_vectors.description: Valid BIP-340 signature and da-scope commitment, but da-cap="unknown-future-cap" is outside all 10 defined capability values. Runtime authority enforcers fail closed (ignore/reject), issuance/request helpers reject, while generic audit/ledger/inspection surfaces display and allow revoking it.
Valid BIP-340 signature, but 441.pubkey is outsider (neither 440.pubkey nor in grantors). Must be rejected by all consumers.
Valid signature and da-scope, but da-cap="shadow" has p === pubkey. Rejected by waggle/tools/grant.mjs and nvoy/mcp/tools/admission.mjs.
Valid signature and da-scope, but da-cap="onboard" has p === pubkey. Rejected by onboard_delegate.mjs and nave.pub write-policy.py.

da-scope salt is 32 non-hex "z" characters and commitment was hashed over 0 salt bytes. Strict hex validators (waggle/src/scope_hash.mjs, nave.pub write-policy.py) reject; exposes Node Buffer.from(salt, "hex") silent truncation in nvoy/mcp/tools/grant_fold.mjs.
da-scope commitment hashed bech32 npub1... UTF-8 string instead of normalized 64-hex pubkey. Fails scopeMatches(agent_grantee.pubkey).

da-cap="task" carries ["expiration", "1700000000"] < evaluation_now (1794700500). Rejected by NIP-40-enforcing folds (admission.mjs, onboard_delegate.mjs, hive-list.mjs, write-policy.py, capabilities.ts, nact).

da-cap="task" carries non-numeric ["expiration", "not-a-timestamp"]. Strict consumers (admission.mjs, onboard_delegate.mjs, hive-list.mjs, write-policy.py) fail closed; highlights capabilities.ts / nact divergence.
First hex nibble of BIP-340 sig is flipped after signing; id still matches content/tags hash, so only cryptographic signature verification catches it.

Valid BIP-340 signature and da-scope for agent_grantee, but two da-cap tags (task, task+act). CAPABILITY-GRANTS.md §1.1: a reader MUST confer nothing; a first-match reader would confer task, a last-match reader task+act.
Valid signature and da-scope, da-cap task, but two p tags (sender_operator, outsider). §1.1: a reader MUST confer nothing to either grantee.

Valid signature from the grantor of both targets, but two e tags (cap-440-task, cap-440-admit). CAPABILITY-GRANTS.md §1.1: issuers MUST NOT produce it; a reader MUST revoke every named target its author may revoke (§5), never only the first. A first-match reader revokes only cap-440-task and leaves cap-440-admit live.
Valid owner-grantor signature but no p tag. CAPABILITY-GRANTS.md §1.1: a reader MUST confer nothing.
Valid owner-grantor signature but no da-cap tag. CAPABILITY-GRANTS.md §1.1: a reader MUST confer nothing.
Valid owner-grantor signature but no da-scope tag. CAPABILITY-GRANTS.md §1.1: a reader MUST confer nothing.
Valid owner-grantor signature but no e tag. CAPABILITY-GRANTS.md §1.1: a reader MUST confer nothing and revoke nothing.
